points.text: Christina Applegate says doctors had attributed her symptoms to multiple sclerosis since 2021, but she was misdiagnosed and still has no explanation for them.
A Google Cloud outage in its London region disrupted services at several UK banks, including Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC.
Erik ten Hag says Cristiano Ronaldo let Manchester United down, and says the club’s leadership broke promises and undermined his authority.
Prince Harry says he wants to work on relationships with his family, including King Charles and Prince William, while acknowledging they may not want reconciliation.
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced visit to Israel and met Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu amid regional tensions and ahead of Israeli elections.
